description: Defines an abstract class BufferedRowIterator used for iterating over rows in Spark SQL execution, managing internal state, timing, and memory metrics.

classes.name: BufferedRowIterator
classes.description: An abstract iterator class used in Spark SQL for processing rows with timing and memory tracking.

methods.name: hasNext
methods.description: Checks if there are more rows to process, calling processNext() if current buffer is empty.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Returns and removes the next InternalRow from the buffer.

methods.name: durationMs
methods.description: Returns the elapsed time in milliseconds since the object was created.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Abstract method to initialize the iterator with an array of InternalRow iterators.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Adds a row to the currentRows buffer.

methods.name: shouldStop
methods.description: Indicates whether processing should stop based on currentRows buffer state.

methods.name: incPeakExecutionMemory
methods.description: Increases peak execution memory for the current task.

methods.name: processNext
methods.description: Abstract method to process input and produce the next row.
